rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA grade and notes thinning zona/ICM/TE appropriately, but relies heavily on the given Gardner score and admits the image is blurry, so image-specific morphology is not especially precise.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrium, oocyte yield, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis well, though some links are somewhat generalized.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor overstatement of certainty around implantation probability prevents a top score.

Recommendations are broadly aligned with IVF practice, including single embryo transfer for a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst and standard luteal support; slight overreach in discussing PGT-A and implantation rates keeps it from perfect alignment.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, follow-up testing, and protocol review, though some advice remains fairly generic rather than highly case-tailored.
